hook.text: A factory had 200 defect types. Pareto analysis showed that just five types caused 80 percent of all failures.

buildup.text: Pareto analysis ranks problems by impact. Fix the vital few and most of the damage disappears.

discovery.text: It combines the 80/20 rule with data.

twist.text: Teams often spread effort evenly across all problems.

climax.text: Before fixing anything, rank the problems. Attack the top 20 percent. That single filter saves more time than any other.

punchline.text: Fix the vital few. Ignore the trivial many.

quiz.question: What does Pareto analysis help you do?
options: Rank problems by impact so you fix the most damaging ones first
